text:
Awesome Cloudflare Self-Hosted 

 Open-source apps that replace a SaaS product, running in your own Cloudflare account .

A Worker, a D1 database, an R2 bucket and a wrangler deploy now cover what used to need a VPS
and a monthly invoice. This list tracks the software taking advantage of that: a booking page
instead of Calendly, a feedback board instead of Canny, an inbox instead of Google Workspace.

Every entry is checked rather than taken on trust: the licence is read from the project's own
licence file and the bindings from its deploy configuration, not from its description.
How the audit works.

 Contents

 

- What belongs here
- Analytics
- Auth, secrets and security
- Blogs, CMS and docs
- Business and operations
- Chat and realtime
- Community and comments
- Developer tools
- Email and inboxes
- Files, images and sharing
- Link shorteners
- Notes, knowledge and sync
- Notifications and push
- Remote access
- Uptime and status pages
- Personal
- Reuse

 

 What belongs here

 In: a complete, deployable application that stands in for a product you'd otherwise pay for,
where the deploy target is your own Cloudflare account.

 Out: frameworks, routers and SDKs; starters and templates; apps you host on your own server
or in Docker; Workers-compatible runtimes you self-host (those replace Cloudflare rather than run
on it); dashboards for administering Cloudflare; proxy and VPN subscription scripts; and API
relays that just shim someone else's SaaS. Full criteria are in the contributing guide.

 Know one that's missing? Suggest it in an issue. 
Three fields, no pull request — the rest is read from the repository.

 

 Analytics

 Project What it replaces 
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 Counterscale   Google Analytics alternative built on Analytics Engine, so traffic volume barely moves the bill. R2 · Analytics Engine · Cron 
 InsightFlare   Privacy-focused web analytics with realtime sessions, running entirely on Cloudflare. D1 · R2 · KV · Durable Objects · Analytics Engine · Cron 
 OpenSEO   Ahrefs and Semrush alternative: keyword research, rank tracking, site audits and backlink data. D1 · R2 · KV · Durable Objects · Workflows · Hyperdrive · Cron 
 traks   Privacy-friendly analytics that deploys into your account in a couple of minutes. D1 · R2 · KV · Durable Objects · Analytics Engine · Pipelines · Cron 

 Auth, secrets and security

 Project What it replaces 
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 2FA   Authy-style TOTP manager with encrypted storage, offline PWA access and backup/restore. KV · Cron · ⚡ 1-click deploy 
 loginbase   Auth0 alternative for passwordless email OTP, GitHub OAuth and rotating refresh sessions on D1 and KV, with a Kotlin Multiplatform client. D1 · KV 
 Melody Auth   Turnkey OAuth 2 and OIDC provider, an Auth0 stand-in for Workers or Node. D1 · KV 
 NodeWarden   Bitwarden-compatible vault server; the official Bitwarden clients talk to it unmodified. D1 · R2 · KV · Durable Objects · Cron 
 Timeseal   Time-locked encryption vault with a dead man's switch, unlocking on a date you set. D1 · R2 

 Blogs, CMS and docs

 Project What it replaces 
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 EmDash   WordPress alternative built on Astro, with plugins sandboxed in Worker isolates. D1 · R2 · Cron · ⚡ 1-click deploy 
 Heyo Docs   Mintlify & Fumadocs Alternative 
 Holocron   Drop-in Mintlify replacement, shipped as a Vite plugin. D1 · KV · Durable Objects · Workers AI · AI Gateway · Email 
 md.page   Turn Markdown into a shareable page; the open engine behind md.page. R2 · KV · Analytics Engine 
 microfeed   Self-hosted CMS for podcasts, blogs, video and curated links, with feeds generated at the edge. D1 · R2 · Queues · Cron 
 Monolith   Serverless blog with pluggable storage adapters and built-in analytics. D1 · R2 · Analytics Engine · Cron 
 Rin   Edge-native blogging platform with its own deploy CLI. 
 SonicJS   Headless CMS built for Workers, with an admin UI and content APIs. D1 · R2 · KV · Email · ⚡ 1-click deploy 

 Business and operations

 Project What it replaces 
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------
